title: High molecular weight plant DNA extraction for PacBio HiFi sequencing
author: Kanae Nishii
materials: Proceed with Qiagen Genomic-tip 100/G following the manufacturer`s protocol. Set up six empty 50 ml Falcon tubes, labelled “QBT”, “Sample”, “QC1”, “QC2”, “QC3”, “Final DNA”. Set up three sets of each.
Discard supernatant and add 1 ml 70% ethanol.

steps.title: Prepare NI buffer on ice
steps.instruction: Prepare 400 ml of NI buffer in a glass beaker and keep it on ice.

steps.title: Prepare sorbitol buffer on ice
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 ml of sorbitol buffer by filling two 50 ml Falcon tubes; keep the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Set up nylon mesh filtration
steps.instruction: Affix a 100 µm nylon mesh to the rim of an empty 500 ml glass beaker with string or tape, or place a Corning cell strainer on a 50 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: Arrange liquid nitrogen and mortar
steps.instruction: Place liquid nitrogen and mortar‑and‑pestles on the fume bench for later grinding.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue and add to NI buffer
steps.instruction: Grind fresh leaf tissue in liquid nitrogen with a mortar and pestle three times to a fine powder; add 1–2 g of powder at a time (≈30 g total) to the NI buffer prepared in step 1. Keep everything on ice.

steps.title: Filter homogenate through nylon mesh
steps.instruction: Filter the NI‑buffer‑tissue mixture through the 100 µm nylon mesh set up in step 3. Keep all solutions on ice during filtering.

steps.title: Distribute filtrate into Falcon tubes
steps.instruction: Divide the filtrate equally into ten 50 ml Falcon tubes and keep the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Add Triton X‑100 and mix
steps.instruction: Add 1/20 volume of 10 % Triton X‑100/NIB to each tube from step 7 and gently mix by inverting. Keep tubes on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 2,000 × g
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 2,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Decant supernatant gently
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant carefully without disturbing or losing the pellet.

steps.title: Add sorbitol buffer and mix
steps.instruction: Add 10 ml of sorbitol buffer to each tube and mix gently.

steps.title: Centrifuge at 3,000 × g
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 3,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Decant and optionally repeat wash
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant by gentle decantation. Optionally repeat the sorbitol‑buffer wash until the supernatant is clear.

steps.title: Add CTAB lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3 ml CTAB lysis buffer, a pinch of PVPP, and 12 µl RNase A to each frozen pellet; mix well with wide‑bore tips. Incubate at 58 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 60 µl proteinase K to each tube; incubate at 58 °C for more than 3 hours but less than 5 hours, shaking the tubes gently on occasion.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4,400 × g for 10 minutes at room temperature. Transfer the clear lysate to a new 50 ml Falcon tube, avoiding any cell debris.

steps.title: Recover remaining lysate by second spin
steps.instruction: Move remaining debris/lysate to 2 ml tubes; centrifuge at 11,000 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature. Collect the clear lysate (≈30 ml total).

steps.title: Adjust lysate pH with HCl
steps.instruction: Adjust the lysate pH to 7.0–7.5 using 0.25 N HCl. Add ≤1 ml of acid at a time, checking the pH with indicator strips after each addition.

steps.title: Dilute lysate with water
steps.instruction: Divide the lysate into two 50 ml Falcon tubes and add an equal volume of Milli‑Q water. Do NOT centrifuge after water addition (low‑salt conditions promote CTAB‑DNA complex formation).

steps.title: Pre‑warm water bath and QF buffer
steps.instruction: Set a water bath to 50 °C and pre‑warm buffer QF to the same temperature.

steps.title: Equilibrate Genomic‑tip column
steps.instruction: Place a Genomic‑tip 100/G column on a 50 ml Falcon tube labeled “QBT”. Add 4 ml buffer QBT and allow it to flow completely by gravity.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Move the Genomic‑tip column to a new 50 ml Falcon tube labeled “Sample”. Load approximately one‑third of the lysate (≈20 ml) onto the column and let it flow through by gravity.

steps.title: Wash column with buffer QC
steps.instruction: Move the column to a tube labeled “QC1”. Add 7.5 ml buffer QC and allow it to flow through by gravity.

steps.title: Repeat QC washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the buffer QC wash two more times on tubes labeled “QC2” and “QC3”. In total the column is washed three times with buffer QC.

steps.title: Elute DNA with pre‑warmed QF
steps.instruction: Apply 5 ml of QF buffer pre‑warmed to 50 °C to the column and allow it to flow through, collecting the eluate.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Aliquot the eluate into 1 ml portions in 2 ml tubes. Add 0.7 ml (0.7 volume) ice‑cold isopropanol, gently invert to mix, and incubate at –20 °C overnight (stop point).

steps.title: First isopropanol spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 11,000 rpm for 10 minutes (room temperature).

steps.title: Second isopropanol spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 11,000 rpm for 10 minutes (room temperature).

steps.title: Dry pellet and remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, invert the tubes on clean tissue to air‑dry the pellet. Optionally warm at 37 °C for 10 minutes to speed ethanol evaporation, but avoid overdrying.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in low‑TE
steps.instruction: Add 15–20 µl of low‑TE buffer (0.1 × TE) to the dried pellet.

steps.title: First DNA elution incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 50 °C with shaking at 300 rpm for 1 hour. Collect the eluted DNA into a 1.5 ml LoBind Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add low‑TE for second elution
steps.instruction: Add another 15–20 µl low‑TE buffer to the pellet for a second elution.

steps.title: Second DNA elution incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 50 °C with shaking at 300 rpm for 1 hour. Collect the second DNA eluate into a separate 1.5 ml LoBind tube (keeping the two eluates separate is recommended).

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA using Qubit and Nanodrop; record A260/A280 and A260/A230 ratios on the Nanodrop. Evaluate fragment size distribution with a TapeStation or FemtoPulse.

steps.title: Remove sorbitol, freeze pellet
steps.instruction: Briefly invert the tubes on dry tissue to remove any remaining sorbitol buffer, taking care not to lose the pellet. Freeze the pellet in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (stop point).
